author: Lucile C. Tate
note: Authorized biography of Boyd K. Packer (1995, Bookcraft). Uses primary sources (interviews with Packer and his wife Donna, family diaries, CES/mission records). Sole major biography of Packer. Part of Tate's Bookcraft biography series covering LeGrand Richards, Matthias F. Cowley, Stephen L Richards, and others.
